title: We value your privacy
body: We use cookies to keep the site working, understand traffic, and measure our marketing. Accept all, reject non-essential, or choose what to allow.

necessary.name: Strictly necessary
necessary.desc: Required for the site and login to work. These are always on.

analytics.name: Analytics
analytics.desc: Help us understand how visitors use the site (e.g. Google Analytics).

marketing.name: Marketing
marketing.desc: Used to measure and personalize our ads (e.g. Google Ads, X, TikTok, Reddit).
